description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched, emotion, mental

A creature that has ever spoken to Paradise cannot willingly attack you. There is no saving throw. The protection ends for a given creature the moment you attack it or one of its allies, and once ended it does not return for that creature. It does not stop a creature that is compelled, mindless, or acting without choosing to — a controlled creature or a hazard is unaffected — and it does not stop anyone who has never spoken to Paradise.
